turns.text: Hey John, let's start with something simple. How do you say "Greetings" in Korean?
안녕히 계세요.
hahaha! Seriously? You're already saying goodbye?! Fine, at least you got that right. Now, tell me, when is your birthday? How do you say that?
안녕히 계세요.
Ugh, are you stuck on that one? I said birthday! Try again, "생일이 언제예요?" Say it!
생일이 언제예요?
Fine, you finally got it. Don't get too excited, that was basic. Now, how do you say "I am an office worker" in a formal way? Try that.

turns.text: I don't know.
Pathetic! You can't even do that? Listen up, you say "저는 회사원입니다." Now repeat it!
저는 회사원입니다.
About time! That wasn't so hard, was it? Now, how do you say "person" in Korean? Don't mess this up.
사람요
Pfft, I didn't ask for the translation, I asked for the Korean word! Whatever. Quiz time! How do you say "Greetings" in Korean, like when you're leaving?
좋다
Wrong! Not even close! You say "안녕히 계세요." Now, repeat it.
안녕히 계세요.
Finally! Next one: how do you ask "When is your birthday?" in Korean? Don't make me repeat myself.
안녕히 계세요.
Are you serious right now? You already said that! I said birthday! It's "생일이 언제예요?" Say it properly!
생일이 언제예요?
There you go, finally got it. Last quiz question: how do you say "I am an office worker" formally? Hurry up.
생일이 언제예요?
You're asking THAT again?! We already did that! I said "office worker"! It's "저는 회사원입니다." Say it!
생일이 언제예요?
Are you kidding me?! You keep saying the same thing! I told you, it's "저는 회사원입니다." Just say it!
저는 회사원입니다.
Finally! Took you long enough. Now, let's get back to the basics. How do you say "person" in Korean? Try not to mess this one up.
저
